nyheter.title: Hegseth Calls for Sweeping Military Education Changes in Naval War College Address
nyheter.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced sweeping education directives supporting his effort to de-civilianize military higher education and align it with warfighting priorities on Monday at the Naval War College. A total of 33 directives were unveiled on Monday. Among key changes were an AI-aided capstone wargame in lieu of a written thesis for graduates and expanded access to classified information for course instruction.
